heading: Reorder bookmarks and folders, and update saved workspaces
summary: Drag bookmark folders and bookmarks into the order you want, and overwrite a saved workspace with the tabs you have open.
changes: Drag a folder heading or a bookmark above or below another. The order is kept after a restart and in every window.
Use Update with Open Tabs… on a saved workspace to replace it with the tabs open in this window.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
